author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Nine! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Are you deep into the #28 kitbash hobby? Do you love grim-gritty neo-noir cyberpunk? Did you actually finish reading BLAME!? This is probably the game for you. Buff This 2141 takes you to New Bilhai, a smoke-haunted slum of towering MegABloks where cybernetically enhanced citizens scrape for an existence by fighting over the slivers of BUFF that lay in their urban wasteland. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://protagonist-games.itch.io/buff-this-2141
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 069 - BUFF THIS 2141 by Protagonist Games
